name: codex-session-improver
description: Turn local and remote Codex session evidence into redacted, reviewable instruction and skill patches applied only when explicitly selected.

interface.shortDescription: Review, comment, and apply session improvements.
interface.longDescription: Analyze settled Codex sessions, initialize automatically on first use, and present exact AGENTS.md, skill, or Markdown patches as review cards that can be applied directly from natural replies or inline comments.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-improver to run the next safety-gated session review now. Initialize with safe defaults if needed, then show every suggestion as an inline-commentable review card.
